title: Reverse Logistics: Product Recall
scope_note: Section 4 (Procedure) steps 4.1-4.9 of SOP-08-A, in DOH Warehouse Operations Manual, 2nd Edition 2022 (data/corpus/DOH_WOM-Manual.pdf, manual pages 151-155 = PDF pages 157-161). This SOP has no contingency section. Step text is the Key Step column verbatim. The two dispatch destinations in 4.5 are modelled as guarded branches, as drawn in the Section 5 flow diagram. Built under docs/annotation-codebook.md: 4.4 and 4.6 follow the branch point rather than the exclusive branches themselves (R3b), since in-stock/already-distributed and supplier/upper-tier are alternatives. Verified against the source document by the author on 2026-09-17; see data/graphs/VERIFICATION.md.

steps.text: Upon receiving the notice for product recall from the FDA and/or supplier, check the inventory of the product with the specific batch/lot/serial number for recall in the inventory
Pick items from the storage area and segregate to a separate area while waiting for its release
steps.condition: the item is in the inventory

steps.text: Notify them to hold further distribution/dispensing and instruct to segregate the item for reverse logistics
steps.condition: the item with the specific batch/lot/serial number for recall was already distributed to the lower tier (establishments or facilities) under your jurisdiction

steps.text: Schedule the pick-up with the identified 3PL to the lower tier (establishments or facilities) under your jurisdiction where items with the specific batch/lot/serial number for recall are located
Upon receiving the items for recall from the lower tier, segregate and store to a separate area while waiting for its release
Put a label "Product Recall" to the stack for proper identification
Schedule the dispatch of the product for recall with the supplier
steps.condition: the item is a direct procurement of your office

steps.text: Schedule the dispatch of the product for recall with the upper tier (DOH Central or Regional Office)
steps.condition: the item is allocated by the upper tier (DOH Central or Regional Office)

steps.text: Prepare the PTR/BL and Gate Pass (indicating the item is for recall)
Counter check the documents, quantities and actual item for recall during dispatch process. Ensure that relevant Documents and gate pass are stamped as received by the 3PL
Consolidate, countercheck and maintain carbon copies of Relevant Documents for filing and review of Supply Officer as necessary
